name: Liminal Leap
summary: Liminal Leap is a pulse-pounding escape room experience set within the unsettling world of the Backrooms. Here, reality unravels, and familiar spaces morph into unrelenting, unsettling corridors. You awaken trapped within a labyrinthine facility – a twisted reflection of the everyday, now warped and hostile. Your Objective: Escape. Unravel the secrets of this insidious place and find your way back to reality. The Peril: The Lurkers: These guardians of the Backrooms manipulate the very fabric of reality. Walls shift, doors vanish, and the map you hold becomes unreliable. Stay alert! A single misstep could lead to a dead end, a trap, or worse. A Multitude of Deaths: The Backrooms are unforgiving. One wrong turn, a misstep in the dark, or a run-in with a Lurker could lead to a gruesome demise. The Challenge: Limited Saves: The first level is a harrowing gauntlet – your wits and reflexes alone will be your guide.
